commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-create
commands.desc: Create a group chat or topic chat; user/bot; --chat-mode group / topic; private/public; invites users/bots; optionally sets bot manager

commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-list
commands.desc: List chats the current user/bot is a member of; defaults to groups; pass --types=p2p,group to include p2p single chats (user-only); user/bot; supports sorting, auto-pagination, --exclude-muted (user-only)

commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-members-list
commands.desc: List members of a chat; returns separate users[] / bots[] buckets; callable as user or bot; --member-types filters which kinds to return; --page-all pagination; surfaces truncations[] when the server caps a bucket

commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-messages-list
commands.desc: List messages in a chat or P2P conversation; user/bot; accepts --chat-id or --user-id, resolves P2P chat_id, supports time range, --order asc/desc sorting, auto-pagination

commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-search
commands.desc: Search visible group chats by --query keyword and/or --member-ids; user/bot; e.g. look up chat_id by group name; supports type filters, sorting, auto-pagination, and --exclude-muted (user identity only)

commands.name: lark-cli im +chat-update
commands.desc: Update group chat name or description; user/bot; updates a chat's name or description

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-group-list
commands.desc: List the caller's feed groups (tags); user-only; supports --page-all auto-pagination

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-group-list-item
commands.desc: List feed cards in a feed group (tag); user-only; enriches each item with chat_name resolved from feed_id; supports --page-all auto-pagination

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-group-query-item
commands.desc: Look up specific feed cards in a feed group (tag) by ID; user-only; enriches each item with chat_name resolved from feed_id

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-shortcut-create
commands.desc: Add chats to the user's feed shortcuts; user-only; oc_xxx chat IDs only; batch up to 10 per call; --head/--tail controls insertion order; partial failures return an ok:false ledger

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-shortcut-list
commands.desc: List one page of the user's feed shortcuts; user-only; omit --page-token for the first page; default output enriches CHAT entries under detail; pass --no-detail to skip the extra lookup and im:chat:read scope

commands.name: lark-cli im +feed-shortcut-remove
commands.desc: Remove chats from the user's feed shortcuts; user-only; batch up to 10 per call; removing an absent shortcut is idempotent success; real per-item failures return an ok:false ledger

commands.name: lark-cli im +flag-cancel
commands.desc: Cancel (remove) a bookmark. When no --flag-type is given, best-effort double-cancel: removes message layer and (when chat_type is determinable) feed layer

commands.name: lark-cli im +flag-create
commands.desc: Create a bookmark on a message; user-only; defaults to message-layer flag; use --flag-type feed for feed-layer flag (item_type auto-detected from chat mode)

commands.name: lark-cli im +flag-list
commands.desc: List bookmarks; user-only; auto-enriches feed-type thread entries with message content; --page-all is capped by --page-limit (default 20, max 1000), and has_more=true means the result is incomplete

commands.name: lark-cli im +message-read-users
commands.desc: user: im:message:readonly (recommended), im:message, im:message:basic, or im:message:get_as_user; bot: im:message:readonly

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-edit
commands.desc: Edit a message's content (text/post, including the attachment zone); bot-only (user identity is rejected by the server); PUT /open-apis/im/v1/messages/:message_id

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-mget
commands.desc: Batch get messages by IDs; user/bot; fetches up to 50 om_ message IDs, formats sender names, expands thread replies

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-read-status
commands.desc: Batch query whether the current user read 1–50 messages; user-only; returns readable items and invalid message IDs

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-reply
commands.desc: Reply to a message (supports thread replies); user/bot; supports text/markdown/post/media replies, reply-in-thread, idempotency key

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-resources-download
commands.desc: Download an image/file from a message; folders are not directly downloadable — expand with im files folder --recursive first, then download the files inside; user/bot

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-search
commands.desc: Search messages across chats (supports keyword, sender, time range filters) with user or bot identity; filters by chat/sender/attachment/time, supports auto-pagination via --page-all / --page-limit, enriches results via batched mget and chats batch_query

commands.name: lark-cli im +messages-send
commands.desc: Send a message to a chat or direct message; user/bot; sends to chat-id or user-id with text/markdown/post/media, supports idempotency key

commands.name: lark-cli im +threads-messages-list
commands.desc: List messages in a thread; user/bot; accepts om_/omt_ input, resolves message IDs to thread_id, supports --order asc/desc sorting, auto-pagination

commands.desc: Forward a message and save as draft (default). Use --confirm-send to send immediately after user confirmation. Original message block included automatically.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +lint-html
commands.desc: Lint mail HTML body for compatibility / safety / Feishu-native rules. Returns warnings/errors and (default) auto-fixed HTML. Read-only: no draft, no API call. Use this BEFORE creating a draft to preview what the writing-path lint would change, or as a CI gate for static HTML templates.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +message-trash
commands.desc: 3. 用户确认后 →

commands.name: lark-cli mail +messages
commands.desc: Use when reading full content for multiple emails by message ID. Accepts comma-separated message IDs; CLI handles more than 20 IDs in batches and merges output.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +reply
commands.desc: Reply to a message and save as draft (default). Use --confirm-send to send immediately after user confirmation. Sets Re: subject, In-Reply-To, and References headers automatically.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +reply-all
commands.desc: Reply to all recipients and save as draft (default). Use --confirm-send to send immediately after user confirmation. Includes all original To and CC automatically.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +send
commands.desc: Compose a new email and save as draft (default). Use --confirm-send to send immediately after user confirmation.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +send-receipt
commands.desc: Send a read-receipt reply for an incoming message that requested one (i.e. carries the READ_RECEIPT_REQUEST label). Body is auto-generated (subject / recipient / send time / read time) to match the Lark client's receipt format — callers cannot customize it, matching the industry norm that read-receipt bodies are system-generated templates, not free-form replies. Intended for agent use after the user confirms.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +share-to-chat
commands.desc: Share an email or thread as a card to a Lark IM chat.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +signature
commands.desc: List or view email signatures with default usage info.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +template-create
commands.desc: Create a personal mail template. Scans HTML local paths (reusing draft inline-image detection), uploads inline images and non-inline attachments to Drive, rewrites HTML to cid: references, and POSTs a Template payload to mail.user_mailbox.templates.create.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +template-update
commands.desc: Update an existing mail template. Supports --inspect (read-only projection), --print-patch-template (prints a JSON skeleton for --patch-file), and flat flags (--set-subject / --set-name / etc). Internally it GETs the template, applies the patch, rewrites local paths to cid: refs, and PUTs a full-replace update (no optimistic locking: last-write-wins).

commands.name: lark-cli mail +thread
commands.desc: Use when querying a full mail conversation/thread by thread ID. Returns all messages in chronological order, including replies and drafts, with body content and attachments metadata, including inline images.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +thread-modify
commands.desc: Modify existing mail threads by adding/removing label IDs or moving them to a folder. Batches thread IDs in groups of 20 and returns success_thread_ids / failed_thread_ids.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +thread-trash
commands.desc: Soft-delete existing mail threads. Batches thread IDs in groups of 20 and returns success_thread_ids / failed_thread_ids. Requires --yes.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +triage
commands.desc: List mail summaries (date/from/subject/message_id). Use --query for full-text search, --filter for exact-match conditions.

commands.name: lark-cli mail +watch
commands.desc: Watch for incoming mail events via WebSocket (requires scope mail:event and bot event mail.user_mailbox.event.message_received_v1 added). Run with --print-output-schema to see per-format field reference before parsing output.
